title: The Toy Pup
description: A lost toy. A little sister who can help.

intro.alt: A sunny garden with a mat and a toy box.

notice: A make-believe family adventure with Anna, Sarah and one-year-old Leah. Read and choose, or listen together.
script:
story 2
variable box = false hidden
scene leah-toy-garden
show Anna happy left
show Sarah curious right
show Leah curious center
camera wide cut
I: Mum sits by Leah on the mat.
Sarah [sad]: My toy pup! It is not here.
Anna [curious]: We can look. A box! A mat!
choice look
option box "Look in the box." -> box ; box = true
option mat "Look by the mat." -> mat
label box
react Anna point
Anna [curious]: A sock! No pup in here.
goto clue
label mat
react Sarah point
Sarah [curious]: A cup! No pup by the mat.
goto clue
label clue
express Leah happy
I: Leah pats the mat. A bit of fur!
Sarah [curious]: Is it my pup?
choice find
option lift "Lift the mat." -> lift
option peek "Have a peek." -> peek
label lift
react Anna reach
Anna [happy]: Up, mat! Here is the pup!
goto found
label peek
react Sarah crouch
Sarah [happy]: I see a nose! Here is my pup!
goto found
label found
express Sarah happy
camera listener Leah cut
Sarah [happy]: You saw it, Leah! You can help!
I: Leah hugs the pup.
camera wide cut
Anna [curious]: A home for the pup?
choice home
option boxbed "A box bed." -> boxbed
option matbed "A mat bed." -> matbed
label boxbed
Sarah [happy]: In the box, pup. Have a nap.
goto callback
label matbed
Sarah [happy]: On the mat, pup. Have a nap.
goto callback
label callback
if box == true -> sock else cup
label sock
Anna [happy]: The sock can be a hat!
goto done
label cup
Anna [happy]: The cup can be a bath!
goto done
label done
express Leah happy
Sarah [happy]: A pup and us. All here!
end

Anna.name: Anna

Sarah.name: Sarah
Sarah.provenance: Family-inspired storybook character styling, guided by David’s supplied family watercolor; original animated illustration.

Leah.name: Leah
